generator: Codex in this conversation, after reading the RevaCSS AI references
method: One documentation-conditioned batch, reviewed with explicit markup contracts; not a blind or independent model comparison.

scenarios.prompt: Create a complete RevaCSS landing page with shared system theme, violet accent, rounded shape, two cards and a native FAQ. Use a native action link to /projects/new.
Integrate two project cards into an existing page using a scoped core and Glass. Keep an unstyled host paragraph outside .reva and make the second card a local Solid exception.

Create a complete RevaCSS dashboard with two native metric cards, a labelled scrollable table, a separate responsive wrapper and a long project name. Use an output for each metric; do not invent a metric component class.

Create a full page with responsive native top-menu markup: one desktop link list and a mobile auto-popover, matching open/close controls and unique IDs. Use destinations / and /projects/new; preserve ordinary navigation semantics.

Render a complete server-returned project form error state posting to the known /projects endpoint. Include a persistent label/name, escaped prior project name, error summary, required input, aria-invalid and linked error text. Leave the CSRF value explicitly application-supplied.
